rubric.notes: Synthetic fixture review: the room-status field makes live availability the first read.
The connected field, signal rail, and fill/outline model avoid an unexamined card-dashboard default.
Large room/time signals remain separate from compact operational labels.
The page answers availability before supporting detail or booking controls.
The asymmetric status field keeps density at overview level and quiets the decision surface.
Lines, grid, labels, and status blocks use the same operational language.
The scoped WF-001 and WF-002 examples remain part of the same live-field direction.
Free, busy, free-soon, selected, and refusal language are visible; documented undrawn states remain explicit.
Committed desktop and mobile captures show the same hierarchy at their declared viewports.
Status is carried by text plus fill, outline, or pattern rather than hue alone.
The sheet labels its illustrative sample data and does not imply customer evidence.
Tokens, components, screens, and source references remain in the canonical Markdown contract.
The visual metaphor does not imply coordinates, routes, navigation, or unscoped booking capability.

recommendation.notes: Synthetic fixture declaration: the record demonstrates candidate Visual Proof evidence for Handoff. It is not a Design Ready or release approval, and it does not attest that a real stakeholder reviewed this example.
